Skill frontmatter moves to the spec shape at the source

534 of the 977 G1 frontmatter violations are gone. Five ork house keys left the top level of all 107 src/skills/*/SKILL.md files: four moved under metadata: and one was deleted. The two shared frontmatter parsers lift the four back out, so every build and docs reader gets the same values as before. The generated docs data proves it: only the content hashes changed.

The source of the shape

No skill generator writes whole frontmatter. The shape came from two places, both fixed: the authoring template in src/skills/CONTRIBUTING-SKILLS.md (now shows the metadata form) and scripts/add-complexity.mjs, which appended a top-level complexity:. Run as it was against the migrated tree, it would have re-added 107 top-level keys. Now it writes into metadata and skips all 107.

metadata:
  category: workflow-automation
  version: "1.2.0"
  author: "OrchestKit"
  complexity: "low"
  tags: "git, commit, version-control, conventional-commits"
